verdict.rationale: 1Password documents its own bulk import from many applications, including CSV exports and direct import on iOS/iPadOS 26 from apps that support the Credential Exchange standard. It also stores one-time passwords. However, no evidence says that authenticator apps are supported import sources or that TOTP seeds come across in bulk. missing for 10: explicit documentation of importing TOTP secrets from authenticator apps (e.g., named sources or a migration flow), confirmation that CSV/Credential Exchange imports carry OTP fields, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand

citations.quote: You can import data into 1Password from many different browsers and applications, including applications that export data in the comma-separated values (CSV) file format
If you use 1Password on iOS or iPadOS 26 or later, you can import data directly from apps that support the Credential Exchange standard.
Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website.
